params.name: q
params.description: The query string to search for. If this is in the format of an EIN, the search will be limited exclusively to the organization with that EIN. Otherwise, this will be a fuzzy search on organization name.

params.name: ein
params.description: The Employer Identification Number (EIN) or TaxID for the nonprofit entity. This is deprecated in favor of the `q` parameter.

params.name: name
params.description: The name of the organization. This is deprecated in favor of the `q` parameter.

params.name: limit
params.description: Limit the size of the list that is returned. The default (and maximum) is 20 objects.

items.docs:
Search for organizations by name or EIN.
This endpoint exists to support a typeahead search or quick lookup by nonprofit EIN or name.
The Get Organization API should be used to retrieve detailed information about an organization.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier for the organization

items.docs: Retrieves the organization with the given ID.

params.name: id
params.description: The unique identifier for the organization to onboard.

items.docs:
Creates a Chariot account for a sandbox recipient organization so that
disbursements to it settle electronically instead of via a mailed check.

By default a sandbox organization has no Chariot account, so disbursements
to it are mailed as a physical check. Call this endpoint to provision an
account for the organization and choose which electronic rail its
disbursements should settle on.
